references.text: Moses repeats the Lord's selection of Bezalel by name, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, as a craftsman for the tabernacle.
Bezalel is mentioned as the one who will carry out the work on the sanctuary together with Oholiab, after the Lord has given them wisdom.
Bezalel makes the ark of the covenant, showing the fulfillment of his calling mentioned in 31:2.
Bezalel, son of Uri, son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, is confirmed to have made everything the Lord commanded Moses.
The genealogy of Bezalel through Hur and Uri from the tribe of Judah is confirmed in Chronicles.
Bezalel, son of Uri, son of Hur, is mentioned as the creator of the bronze altar that stood before the Lord's tabernacle.
